description: Clock standards & lint compliance baseline for the 'no new debt' CI gate.
note: This baseline is used by .github/workflows/ci.yml. The CI fails ONLY if a PR regresses these numbers (i.e. makes compliance worse). Reducing them is the goal. Updated to reflect current fleet size (498 clocks) and error counts from the 2026-08-12 state-of-the-art assessment.
